caption:
The best mountain biking in Costa Rica isn't found on manicured park trails; it is carved into the old, working doubletracks that connect our high mountain valleys. I have spent years riding these backroads, learning how the volcanic clay changes with the seasons and which ridges offer the cleanest line of sight to the coast. When I design a cycling journey for My Adventure Costa Rica, I look for these exact transitions—where the pavement ends and the real terrain begins.
